styleLock.edge: black-violet comic ink; old B01/rim rules superseded
styleLock.promptTemplate: Premium dark arcane fantasy comic-ink game UI. Bold tapered black-violet #1b1226 ink contours, 2-3 flat hard-edged cel tones per material, cool violet-blue shadows and warm upper-left key. Forged dark gunmetal, violet-black recesses, worn bronze/gold edge trim, restrained jewel inlays. No soft painterly blending, candy gradients, bubbly shapes or mobile-casual styling. Original design, no letters, numbers, words, watermarks or labels.
